about_html:
{site} is a light-hearted daily destination for curious people. Every day we publish fresh horoscopes for all twelve zodiac signs, a new general-knowledge trivia quiz, a five-letter word puzzle, live holiday countdowns, and easy-to-read explainers about the subjects people are curious about.

How we create content

Our editorial process uses AI-assisted drafting and translation under strict guidelines: evergreen, family-friendly topics only; no news reporting, no medical, legal or financial advice; and only well-established facts. Horoscopes and quizzes are entertainment. If you spot a mistake, please contact us and we will correct it quickly.
contact_lead: Questions, corrections, partnership ideas or feedback? We read every message.
contact_reply: We usually reply within 2–3 business days.
form_ok: Thank you! Your message was sent.
form_error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
privacy_html:
This policy explains what information is collected when you visit {site} ({url}).

Information we collect

We do not ask you to create an account. If you write to us through the contact page, we receive the name, email address and message you choose to send, and we use them only to reply to you. Contact messages are delivered to us by the form service Web3Forms. Your language choice and game progress are stored only in your own browser.

Advertising and cookies

We use Google AdSense to show advertising. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.

You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings, or opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies at www.aboutads.info. Learn more about how Google uses information from sites that use its services.

Visitors in the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland are asked for consent through a consent message before personalised ads are shown.

Children

This site is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy; the date above shows the latest version. Questions: use our contact page.
terms_html:
By using {site} you agree to these terms.

Entertainment and general information

Horoscopes, quizzes and puzzles are provided for entertainment. Articles are general information and are not professional advice of any kind. We work to keep content accurate but cannot guarantee it is complete or error-free.

External links and ads

We are not responsible for the content of third-party websites or advertisements.

Contact

Use our contact page.
games_desc: Quick, free brain games you can play right in your browser — no download, no sign-up.
game_memory_desc: Flip the cards, find all the pairs and build combos. Three levels from easy to hard.
game_2048_desc: Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers. Can you reach 2048?
game_ttt_desc: X and O against a smart computer. Can you beat it on Hard?
how_memory: Tap a card to flip it, then tap another. If they match they stay open. Find all 8 pairs!
how_2048: Swipe (or use the arrow keys) to move all tiles. Two equal tiles merge into one. Reach 2048 to win.
how_ttt: You are X, the computer is O. Take turns placing your mark. Three in a row — across, down or diagonal — wins.
offline_text: Check your connection — your daily horoscope, quiz and games will be right here when you're back online.
banner_text: Free • fast • your daily horoscope, quiz and games in one tap
ios_hint: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
game_sudoku_desc: The classic number puzzle. Fill the grid so every row, column and box has 1–9.
how_sudoku: Tap a cell, then a number. Each row, column and 3×3 box must contain the digits 1 to 9 exactly once. You have 3 hints and can make 3 mistakes.
game_math_desc: 60 seconds of quick mental math. Build a streak to multiply your points!
how_math: Pick the right answer as fast as you can. 3 correct in a row doubles your points, 10 in a row triples them. A wrong answer costs 3 seconds.
game_simon_desc: Watch the colors light up, then repeat the sequence. How long can you go?
how_simon: Each round adds one more color to the sequence. Watch carefully, then tap the colors in the same order.
math_intro: Answer as many sums as you can in 60 seconds. Streaks multiply your score!
simon_intro: Press Start and remember the colors.
game_chess_desc: Play chess against the computer — from friendly Easy to tricky Hard.
how_chess: You play White. Tap a piece to see its moves, then tap where to go. Checkmate the black king to win. Pawns promote to a queen automatically.
game_ludo_desc: Roll the dice and race your tokens home against 3 computer players.
how_ludo: You are Red. Roll a 6 to bring a token out. Move around the board and into your home column. Land on an opponent to send it back! Rolling a 6 or capturing gives you another turn. Stars are safe squares.
pick_sign: Tap your sign — we'll remember it.
game_blocks_desc: Drag the blocks onto the board and fill rows or columns to clear them. How high can you score?
how_blocks: Drag a block from the tray onto the board (or tap a block, then tap the board). Fill a full row or column to clear it. Clear several lines at once or in a row for big combos. The game ends when none of your blocks fits. Your game is saved automatically.
game_solitaire_desc: The classic Klondike card game. Tap a card and it jumps to the best move.
how_solitaire: Build four piles from Ace to King, one for each suit. On the table, stack cards in descending order with alternating colors; only a King can go on an empty column. Tap the deck to draw cards. Tap any face-up card to move it automatically. Your game is saved automatically.
compat_desc: Pick your zodiac sign and your partner's sign to see how well you match in love, friendship and work.
compat_fire_fire: Two fires make a blaze: passion, adventure and big plans come easily. Just take turns leading so pride doesn't turn into a contest.
compat_earth_earth: A calm, loyal and practical pair. You build trust step by step and share the same values. Add a little surprise now and then to keep the spark alive.
compat_air_air: Endless conversation and shared curiosity. You keep each other inspired and laughing. Turn your ideas into real plans together so things don't stay up in the air.
compat_water_water: A deep emotional bond where you understand each other without words. Protect your shared world, but remember to say clearly what you need.
compat_fire_air: Air feeds fire: an energetic, fun and social match. You push each other to try new things. Keep promises small and real so excitement turns into trust.
compat_earth_water: Water nourishes earth: a caring, stable and tender match. One brings security, the other brings feeling. Talk openly about worries before they grow.
compat_fire_earth: Fire wants speed, earth wants safety. It takes patience, but together you can be bold and solid at the same time. Respect each other's rhythm.
compat_fire_water: Steam and sparks: strong attraction with strong emotions. Gentle words matter a lot here. When you balance passion with kindness, this pair can be unforgettable.
compat_earth_air: Head in the clouds meets feet on the ground. You see life differently, which can teach you both a lot. Give each other freedom and a clear plan.
compat_air_water: Mind meets heart. Air brings ideas and lightness, water brings depth and care. Listen to feelings, not only to words, and you'll grow closer.
tarot_desc: Tap the deck to draw your tarot card of the day and read its message. A new card waits for you every day.
tarot_tap: Tap a card to reveal your card
tarot_back: Come back tomorrow for a new card ✨
tarot_0_m: A fresh start is calling you. Be curious, travel light and say yes to something new today.
tarot_1_m: You already have the skills you need. Focus your energy and turn one idea into action.
tarot_2_m: Listen to your intuition. The answer you're looking for is quieter than you think.
tarot_3_m: Take care of yourself and the people you love. Creativity and comfort bloom today.
tarot_4_m: Structure brings freedom. Make a clear plan and stand firmly by your decisions.
tarot_5_m: Learn from someone wise, or share what you know. Traditions can guide you now.
tarot_6_m: A choice from the heart. Be honest about what you really want and who you want beside you.
tarot_7_m: Determination wins. Keep your eyes on the goal and move forward with confidence.
tarot_8_m: Gentle courage beats force. Stay calm, be patient, and you will handle what comes.
tarot_9_m: Take a little time alone to think. A quiet moment will bring a bright idea.
tarot_10_m: Things are turning in your favor. Stay open — luck likes people who are ready.
tarot_11_m: Fairness and truth matter today. Make balanced choices and keep your word.
tarot_12_m: Look at the situation from a new angle. A short pause can unlock the way forward.
tarot_13_m: Something old is ending to make space for something better. Let go with grace.
tarot_14_m: Balance is your superpower today. Mix patience with action and avoid extremes.
tarot_15_m: Notice a habit that holds you back. Naming it is the first step to breaking free.
tarot_16_m: A surprise may shake things up, but it clears the way for something more solid.
tarot_17_m: Hope returns. Believe in your dreams and share your light with others.
tarot_18_m: Not everything is clear yet. Trust your feelings and take one careful step at a time.
tarot_19_m: Joy, success and good energy surround you. Smile — today is made for shining.
tarot_20_m: Time to rise to a new level. Forgive the past and answer your true calling.
tarot_21_m: A cycle is complete. Celebrate how far you've come and get ready for the next adventure.

tile_moon: Today's moon and what it means
moon_m0: A fresh start. A good moment to set intentions and plan something new.
moon_m1: Ideas start to grow. Take the first small steps toward your goals.
moon_m2: Time for action and decisions. Push through small obstacles.
moon_m3: Refine and improve. Patience now brings better results.
moon_m4: Things come to light. Celebrate, share and enjoy what you've achieved.
moon_m5: Gratitude and sharing. Pass on what you have learned.
moon_m6: Let go of what no longer helps you. Tidy up and forgive.
moon_m7: Rest and recharge. Reflect quietly before the next cycle.
game_ws_desc: Find all the hidden words in the grid. A new themed puzzle every day in your language.
how_ws: Words can go across, down or diagonally. Drag your finger (or mouse) from the first to the last letter of a word, or tap the first and then the last letter. Find all the words to win.
game_mj_desc: The relaxing tile-matching classic. Find pairs of free tiles and clear the board.
how_mj: Tap two identical tiles to remove them. A tile can only be picked if nothing is on top of it and its left or right side is free. Use Hint if you're stuck, or Shuffle when there are no moves left. Every deal can be solved.
